review_comment: These two methods are the real magic. And the shared code in `Phased` and `EsqlSession`.
See class level javadoc for what's happening here.

Isn't it a bit late to do it here? As I understand it, we already computed everything and got the data into the coordinator.
I guess it's better to have a limit than not have anything; just to understand it

In an ideal world we wouldn't have a limit here but we don't have proper accounting for `Block`s in the request objects - they don't use the Breaker at all. So doing this copy shifts it out of tracking-land. I think it's important to get the tracking right before we GA this so I'm adding that to the follow-ups list. I want to keep it out of this PR because I don't really know how to do it and it's going to touch a bunch of stuff.
